verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a self-hosted agent gateway, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a first-party SDK in any language. The documented programmatic surfaces (an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint, a tool-invoke HTTP endpoint, an MCP server mode, the CLI) are adjacent integration points, not official SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
